# FOR ADVERTISING PARTNERS, AND CURIOUS READERS
#
# This file tells automated web crawlers which parts of this site they may
# visit. Our policy here is simple: all crawlers may access all public paths.
# We set no path restrictions and request no crawl delay in this file.
#
# FOR AD AGENCIES AND AD NETWORKS
#
# Advertising crawlers are welcome to review our public pages and ads.txt.
# AmazonAdBot is explicitly allowed below, as requested by our ad partners.
# The general rule also allows all other crawlers, including advertising,
# search, and verification crawlers.
#
# For authorized advertising sellers, see /ads.txt. This robots.txt file
# describes crawler access; it does not list or authorize advertising sellers.
#
# FOR HUMAN EDITORS
#
# Lines beginning with # are explanatory comments, ignored by crawlers.
# The User-agent and Allow lines below are the operative crawling rules.
# Keep both groups unrestricted unless a policy change has been approved.
#
# These rules express crawling permission. They do not override security
# controls, guarantee a successful request, or grant content reuse rights.
#
# ==================================

# Explicit permission for Amazon's advertising crawler.
User-agent: AmazonAdBot
Allow: /

# Permission for all other crawlers across all public paths.
User-agent: *
Allow: /
